script.title: Case 11: The Sock
script.synopsis: The Inspector opens a formal case on a single grey sock that keeps reappearing in the hallway, moves it three times, and discovers it is clinging to her own jacket.

beats.beat: Silent close on the sock under a formal case card, hem sliver at top edge (adapts T-20261007-05 and T-20261007-02).
She files the sock on its hook and states the case.
Sock is back; she boxes it on the shoe shelf and calls it a repeat offender.
Camera drifts behind her and shows the sock clinging to her collar.
Two-finger tap, verdict 'The suspect is me', she re-hangs it and it clings again.
Final pose matches the opening stillness, ready to loop.

scenes.action: Frame one is a single grey sock lying on the oak floor beside the foot of the coat-hook rail, with a sliver of aubergine jacket hem at the extreme top edge. Held still for 1.5 s, then a shoe and the lower edge of a clipboard enter frame-right as the camera settles.
scenes.performance: Silent. The sock holds the frame alone; the arriving shoe stops precisely a hand's width from it, as if respecting a crime-scene marker.
scenes.microexpression: None visible; face out of frame.

camera.shot: tight close-up, low angle on the floor
camera.movement: propped phone with one small settle-wobble, then a slow tilt up 10 degrees as the shoe arrives
camera.rig: phone propped against the skirting board

scenes.lighting: Key: soft daylight from a window at frame-left end of the hallway; fill: pale wall bounce from the right; one colour bounce: warm oak floorboards lifting the underside of the jacket; contact shadows: soft dark under the sock, under the hook and under her shoe soles. Light must not change across the clip.

scenes.action: The camera rises to a medium shot of the Inspector standing over the sock. She reads her clipboard, lifts the sock between two fingers, hangs it on the nearest coat hook, smooths it flat and turns her back to the camera to write. The grey toe of a second sock is faintly visible at the nape of her collar as she turns.
scenes.performance: Invested task: log the sock into the register and restore it to its hook with exact, procedural movements; eyes go from clipboard to sock to hook, never to camera.
scenes.microexpression: Brief tightening around the mouth as she checks the sock is aligned.

scenes.action: The grey sock is back on the floor at her feet. She stares at the empty hook, then at the sock, picks it up, drops it into a small plain cardboard box on the shoe shelf, closes the flap and turns away. As she turns the camera drifts around behind her and the sock is again lying on the floor by her heel; the grey toe of a second sock is visibly clinging to the nape of her aubergine jacket.
scenes.performance: Invested task: contain the suspect in the evidence box and secure the lid; she searches the hallway corners for the culprit, eyes sweeping left to right, and never checks herself.
scenes.microexpression: Eyebrows lower one millimetre, jaw set in stern suspicion.

scenes.action: With the camera behind her, the Inspector gives one slow two-finger tap on the clipboard, then says her verdict. She reaches back, peels the sock from her collar, hangs it on the hook, steps back one pace and the sock drops free to cling to her jacket again at the nape. Final pose is her standing square to the hook, matching the opening stillness.
scenes.performance: Invested task: close the case with formal finality; she squares her shoulders, delivers the verdict to the hook rather than to camera, and files the sock with great ceremony.
scenes.microexpression: Eyes close for one long blink, then warm disappointment settles on her mouth.

continuity.identity_anchors: Oval face, straight dark brows, small round glasses pushed slightly down the nose, neutral expression that breaks into warm disappointment rather than anger. Silhouette: Aubergine utility jacket with four flap pockets, bright circular inspection lamp on a chest strap, tiny clipboard on a lanyard, hair in a tight low bun.
continuity.costume: Aubergine utility jacket with four flap pockets, bright circular inspection lamp on chest strap, tiny clipboard on lanyard, hair in tight low bun, small round glasses, dark trousers and plain flat shoes, no readable text or logos.
continuity.notes: Moving props: grey sock (floor, hook, box, collar, hook), small plain cardboard box. The grey toe sliver of a second sock at her nape is visible from S2 onward. No cables, chargers, sockets, tape or cones. Single speaker, no off-camera voices. Signature two-finger clipboard tap occurs once, in S4. Light stays constant.
